name: SetMemberPermissions
description: Set what a member of the sender's account group may spend (controller only).

params.name: sender_privkey
params.help: the signing key: 32-byte Ed25519 seed as 64 hex; '-' or omitted = ZBC_KEY

params.name: flags
params.help: 1 = may spend, 3 = may spend and move tokens, 0 = receive only

params.name: spend_limit
params.help: atomic ZBC per period (0 = no limit)

params.name: period_blocks
params.help: blocks per limit window (required when spend_limit > 0)

notes: Rule account_groups: accepted from its activation height.
The C++ tools refuse a spend_limit above 0 with period_blocks 0.
